statement: Executed probes behind every 'blocked' claim in driver-row-status.json. Each entry records the command that was run and what it returned; a precondition nobody executed is not a precondition, it is an excuse.

python_driver_from_source.conclusion: the Python driver CANNOT be imported from the locked source tree: python/typedb/native_driver_wrapper.py and native_driver_python.so are SWIG outputs produced by the Bazel genrules in python/BUILD (@typedb_dependencies//builder/swig:python.bzl). Neither bazel nor swig exists here, so a from-source Python driver is blocked; the lane instead runs the OFFICIAL published wheel of the same version and proves module-for-module byte identity with the locked tree.

pristine_server_lane.conclusion: no typedb_server_bin is built under sources/typedb-pristine. Building one needs a cargo target directory of the order the fork's already occupies (16448829500 bytes measured); the filesystem has 1051377664 bytes free. The pristine (plan profile U0) driver lane is therefore blocked on disk capacity in this environment, not on tooling. The executed lanes use the fork server, whose checkout dirt is recorded explicitly in every bundle.
